svg.title: Selection, bubble and insertion sort on [5, 2, 4, 6, 1, 3], one row per pass. Selection grows a sorted prefix by swapping in the minimum; bubble grows a sorted suffix as the largest value bubbles right; insertion keeps the front sorted among itself and slides each new element into place. Green cells are the sorted part, orange outlines are what moved

g.text: Orange outline: the elements that moved in that pass.
